tasks.title: Create build.mjs that renders content.json to dist/index.html

acceptance_criteria.text: `build.mjs` exists at the project root, imports only `node:` builtins, and `package.json` gains no dependencies (covers: REQ-1)
A valid sample `content.json` exists at the project root with `name`, `tagline`, `about`, `projects` (`{title, summary, url}`), `contact.email` (covers: REQ-3)
`node build.mjs` exits 0 and writes `dist/index.html` (covers: REQ-1, REQ-10)
The output has an inline `<style>` element, no `<link rel="stylesheet">` and no `<script>` (covers: REQ-2)
The output's `<title>` text equals `name` (covers: REQ-9)
The output has exactly one `<h1>`, containing `name`, with the tagline directly after it (covers: REQ-4)
The output has an About section containing the `about` text (covers: REQ-5)
The output has a Projects section with one card per project, each title an `<a href>` to its `url` (covers: REQ-6)
The output has a Contact section with an `<a href="mailto:EMAIL">` link (covers: REQ-7)
The sections appear in the order h1+tagline, About, Projects, Contact (covers: REQ-8)
`CONTENT_FILE=/tmp/x.json OUT_DIR=/tmp/out node build.mjs` reads the named file and writes `/tmp/out/index.html` (creating the dir), leaving `dist/` untouched (covers: REQ-11)
Running the build twice produces byte-identical `index.html` (covers: REQ-18)
A project with no `url` renders its title as plain text: no `<a>`, no `href="#"`, no `href=""` (covers: REQ-12)
`projects: []` renders the Projects section with "Projects are coming soon." and no `<ul>`/`<ol>`/`<li>` (covers: REQ-13)
A title `Rock & Roll` appears as `<b>Rock & Roll</b>`; every interpolated string (attributes included) is escaped (covers: REQ-14)

tasks.title: Make build.mjs fail cleanly on missing, unparsable or name-less content

acceptance_criteria.text: `CONTENT_FILE=<nonexistent> node build.mjs` exits 1, stderr is exactly one line naming the problem (covers: REQ-15)
`CONTENT_FILE=<file containing {not json> node build.mjs` exits 1, stderr is exactly one line naming the problem (covers: REQ-15)
In both cases above, no `index.html` is written to `OUT_DIR` (covers: REQ-16)
Valid JSON without `name` exits 1 with exactly one stderr line, and writes no `index.html` (covers: REQ-17)

tasks.title: Add a node --test suite covering the UC-BuildSite Test Surface

acceptance_criteria.text: `build.test.mjs` exists at the project root and uses only `node:test`, `node:assert` and other `node:` builtins (covers: REQ-1)

The suite has a test per Test Surface row (TS-INV-01..06, TS-ERR-CONTENT_MISSING, TS-ERR-CONTENT_INVALID_JSON, TS-ERR-NAME_MISSING, TS-NOGO-01, TS-NOGO-03, TS-NOGO-05), each named with its row id (covers: REQ-12, REQ-13, REQ-14, REQ-15, REQ-16, REQ-17, REQ-18)
The tests never write to the real `content.json` or `dist/` (covers: REQ-11)
